transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Daxing Airport Express serves Caoqiao, Daxing Xincheng and Daxing Airport; Caoqiao offers transfers to metro lines 10 and 19. Boarding at the airport is on Level B1 of the terminal. Trains run from Caoqiao to the airport from 05:30 to 22:30; from the airport to Caoqiao, they run from 06:00 to 23:00 Monday to Saturday and until 23:30 on Sundays. Children up to and including 1.3 m tall travel free when accompanied by a fare-paying adult.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Baggage can be stored for 1 to 90 days. The Level 2 facility is 30 m east of the east exit of the domestic arrivals hall and is open round the clock; the Level 4 facility is at the end of island H on the east side of the departures hall and is open from 07:00 to 22:00. Charges are per piece per day and depend on baggage size. Passengers eligible for 240-hour visa-free transit may store 1 piece of baggage free of charge.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The aviation-themed children’s play area has model aircraft, slides and other play equipment. It is in Concourse A near gate A10 and is open from 08:00 to 21:00.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: The airport offers the free BDIA-FREE-WiFi network. The airport’s illustrated instructions describe passport login: select ID Login on the authentication page, choose the document type and take a photo of the document.
